text: 你很快确认了自己的发现：这里是前所未见的史前生物遗存地。沙地和黏稠泥浆里到处都是不属于北方现代动物的足迹。然而，你的专长是人类学，古生物学研究有限。

en.title: Alone Against the Frost · 225
text: You quickly confirm your discovery of a redoubt of unprecedented prehistoric survival. Animal tracks attributable to no modern beast of the North abound in the sand and bubbly mud; however, your specialty is anthropology—your paleontological studies have been limited.
